Hildegard 0.1.10 is a pre-alpha. It fixes updating from 0.1.5 and earlier, which could leave Hildegard stopped, and
signs the skills you upload into other apps.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update`.

## New

- **Signed skills for other apps.** `hildegard.plugin`, each skill zip and `SHA256SUMS` now come with a `.minisig`
  signature. Check one before you upload it:
  `minisign -Vm hildegard.plugin -P RWRuTouBXVYfx+4G+nXGdy1FJZ87J5avjw/lHDAES6YnmumXkpK7y0FV`.
- **Share a GPU only when it's free.** On a computer that shares its GPU with your other devices, turn on **Only when
  it's free** in Settings › Devices (or `hildegard choir opportunistic on`). Your other devices' renders then wait
  behind that computer's own work, step aside when its own work arrives, and start only while nothing else is using
  it. Off, the default, they take their turn as before.
- **NVIDIA DGX Spark.** Hildegard counts the GB10's shared memory, so models fit and render on it. It hasn't been tried
  on a real Spark yet.
- **Pi.** Hildegard can run the Pi coding agent on your own API key or a local model, as it runs OMP.
- **A roadmap,** led by skill suggestions that can't be turned into an attack:
  [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/baney75/hildegard/blob/main/ROADMAP.md).

## Fixed

- **Updating from an older Hildegard.** An update started by Hildegard itself passed the old version's folder on to
  the new one, which then looked for its files there and didn't start. The installer now clears those paths first, so
  updating from any earlier version works, 0.1.5 included.
- **A failed update goes back.** If anything in an update fails, from a download to the new version's setup, the
  installer stops whatever it started, switches back to the version it replaced and its Node.js, and starts that one
  again, so Hildegard keeps running and "still installed" is true. The new version stays on disk for
  `hildegard install` to try again, and the last line says which version runs.
- **Update now finds the release.** **Update** in the Studio, the Omarchy panel and `update_hildegard` used to say
  "up to date" until Hildegard's next six-hourly check. Each now looks for the newest release first.
- The Hildegard skill no longer gives image sizes for one social network.

## Changed

- A release bundle now always uses its own presets and files. `HILDEGARD_RESOURCES` and `HILDEGARD_PRESETS_DIR` set
  in your environment no longer override them: an older version updating to this one passed its own values on, which
  is what stopped updates from 0.1.5. To try other presets, run Hildegard from a checkout of its source.
